vulnerability.name: USN-5806-1
vulnerability.description: Hiroshi Tokumaru discovered that Ruby did not properly handle certain user input for applications which generate HTTP responses using cgi gem. An attacker could possibly use this issue to maliciously modify the response a user would receive from a vulnerable application.

statements.status_notes: Ruby could allow for internet traffic to be modified if a vulnerable application processed malicious user input. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
